title: Planetary Ephemeris
text: Implement position and velocity of astronomical objects, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Center} sets Center body; {Units} sets the output units, {Epoch}, {Ephemeris model}, {Target}, {Limit ephemerides date range} sets the option to enable start and end of range of ephemeris, {Start date (JD)} sets the start date of ephemerides date range, {End date (JD)} sets the end date of ephemerides date range, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior and {Calculate velocity} sets the calculate rate of target barycenter. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: T JD
ports.summary: Julian date scalar | positive | between minimum and maximum Julian dates

params.name: Epoch
params.values: Epoch Julian date (default) | T0 and elapsed Julian time

params.name: Ephemeris model
params.values: Ephemeris model DE405 (default) | DE421 | DE423 | DE430 | DE432t

params.name: Center
params.values: Center body Sun (default) | Mercury | Venus | Earth | Moon | Mars | Jupiter | Saturn | Uranus | Neptune | Pluto | Solar system barycenter | Earth-Moon barycenter

params.name: Target
params.values: Target body Sun (default) | Mercury | Venus | Earth | Moon | Mars | Jupiter | Saturn | Uranus | Neptune | Pluto | Solar system barycenter | Earth-Moon barycenter

params.name: Limit ephemerides date range
params.values: Option to enable start and end of range of ephemeris data off (default) | on

params.name: Start date (JD)
params.values: Start date of ephemerides date range juliandate(2020, 1, 1) (default) | Julian date

params.name: End date (JD)
params.values: End date of ephemerides date range juliandate(2050, 1, 1) (default) | Julian date

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error

params.name: Calculate velocity
params.values: Calculate rate of target barycenter on (default) | off
